home.introTitle: Excellence in languages for professional and corporate growth
home.introText: English Way Express develops bespoke language solutions for companies and professionals who need to communicate with precision, confidence, and performance in real-world scenarios.
home.overviewTitle: Language consultancy focused on real-world application
home.overviewText1: For over 13 years, English Way Express has provided tailored courses, coaching, consultancy, translation, interpretation, and preparation for corporate contexts where language needs to deliver concrete results.
home.overviewText2: Our work combines communicative methodology, rapid context reading, and sector-specific customisation to support everything from internal routines to high-exposure situations.
home.scenariosText: Rather than offering standardised packages, English Way Express structures language support according to the situation in which communication needs to perform.
home.clientsText: We have built long-term partnerships with large companies across different sectors of the economy.
home.faqText: Some common questions for those evaluating language courses, consultancy, or personalised language support.
home.contactText: Talk to our team to design the ideal plan for your company or for your individual development.

faqItems.question: Does English Way Express serve both companies and individuals?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Our work includes both corporate projects for teams and leaders, as well as individual coaching for professionals with specific goals.

faqItems.question: Are the solutions tailored or are there ready-made packages?
faqItems.answer: After a detailed assessment, we develop a tailored solution based on each client's goals and specific needs.

faqItems.question: Does English Way Express only provide services in English?
faqItems.answer: We provide solutions in seven languages: English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, Mandarin and Japanese.

faqItems.question: How do I start a conversation about a project?
faqItems.answer: Contact us through the contact form or WhatsApp to schedule an online or in-person meeting, discuss your needs and identify the best solutions.
